mapper.sql: select distinct bm_storage_material.id, bm_material.id as material_id, bm_material.name as material_name, bm_material.code as material_code, bm_material.merge_code as merge_code, bm_material.specification as material_specification, bm_material.material_category_id as material_category_id, bm_material_category.name as material_category_name, bm_material_category.category_type as material_category_type, cast(bm_storage_material.no as signed) as material_no, bm_storage_material_batch.id as material_batch_id, bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no, bm_storage_material.unit_id, bm_storage_material.unit_extend_id, bm_storage_material.init_quantity, bm_storage_material.consume_quantity, bm_storage_material.available_quantity, bm_storage_material.reserve_quantity, bm_storage_material_batch.expired_date, bm_storage_material.material_position_id, bm_storage_material.container, bm_storage_material.container_id, bm_storage_material.sign_status, bm_storage_material_batch.original_batch_no, bm_storage_material_batch.factory_batch_no, bm_storage_material_reserve.batch_id as product_plan_id from bm_storage_material left join bm_storage_material_batch on bm_storage_material_batch.id = bm_storage_material.storage_material_batch_id and bm_storage_material_batch.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_material on bm_material.id = bm_storage_material.material_id and bm_material.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_material_category on bm_material_category.id = bm_material.material_category_id and bm_material.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_cargo_position on bm_storage_material.material_position_id = bm_cargo_position.id and bm_cargo_position.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_resource_permission on bm_cargo_position.id = bm_resource_permission.resource_id left join bm_storage_material_reserve on bm_storage_material_reserve.storage_material_id = bm_storage_material.id and bm_storage_material_reserve.is_deleted = 0

select.where:
bm_storage_material_batch.is_deleted = 0 and bm_material.is_deleted = 0 and bm_storage_material.is_deleted = 0 and bm_storage_material_batch.id = #{query.storageMaterialBatchId} and (bm_storage_material.available_quantity + bm_storage_material.reserve_quantity) != 0 and bm_cargo_position.is_deleted = 0 and bm_cargo_position.is_enable = 'TRUE'
and 1 = 2
and bm_storage_material.material_position_id in
#{item}
and bm_storage_material.no like concat('%' , #{query.materialNo} , '%')
order by bm_storage_material.create_time desc, material_no desc

bm_storage_material_batch.is_deleted = 0 and bm_material.is_deleted = 0 and (bm_storage_material.sign_status is null or bm_storage_material.sign_status = 1) and bm_storage_material.is_deleted = 0 and (bm_storage_material.available_quantity + bm_storage_material.reserve_quantity) != 0 and bm_cargo_position.is_deleted = 0 and bm_cargo_position.is_enable = 'TRUE'
and bm_storage_material.storage_material_batch_id = #{query.storageMaterialBatchId}
and bm_storage_material.no like concat('%' , #{query.materialNo} , '%')
and 1 = 2
and bm_storage_material.material_position_id in
#{item}
order by bm_storage_material.create_time desc, material_no desc
bm_storage_material_batch.is_deleted = 0 and bm_material.is_deleted = 0 and bm_storage_material.is_deleted = 0 and bm_storage_material.id = #{id}

mapper.select: select id from bm_storage_material where no = #{materialNo} and is_deleted = 0

select bm_storage_material.id as storage_material_id, cast(bm_storage_material.no as signed) as storage_material_no, bm1.id as material_id, bm1.merge_code, bm1.name as material_name, bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no, (bm_storage_material.available_quantity = 0 and bm_storage_material.reserve_quantity = 0) as use_up, bm_storage_material.init_quantity, bm_storage_material.consume_quantity, bm_storage_material.available_quantity, bm_storage_material.reserve_quantity, bm_storage_material.container as container_name, if(bm_storage_material.unit_extend_id is null, bm_storage_material.unit_id, bm_storage_material.unit_extend_id) as unit_id, concat(bm_cargo_position.code, '-', bm_cargo_position.position) as position, bm2.name as reserve_product_name, bm_storage_material_reserve.batch_no as reserve_batch_no, bm_storage_material_reserve.reserve_user_id, bm_storage_material_reserve.reserve_time from bm_storage_material left join bm_storage_material_batch on bm_storage_material.storage_material_batch_id = bm_storage_material_batch.id and bm_storage_material_batch.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_cargo_position on bm_storage_material.material_position_id = bm_cargo_position.id and bm_cargo_position.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_storage_material_reserve on bm_storage_material_reserve.storage_material_id = bm_storage_material.id and bm_storage_material_reserve.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_material bm1 on bm_storage_material.material_id = bm1.id and bm1.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_material bm2 on bm_storage_material_reserve.product_id = bm2.id and bm2.is_deleted = 0 where bm_storage_material.is_deleted = 0 and (bm_storage_material.sign_status is null or bm_storage_material.sign_status = 1)
and bm_storage_material.storage_material_batch_id = #{pageQuery.storageMaterialBatchId}
and bm_storage_material.no like concat('%' , #{pageQuery.storageMaterialNo} , '%')
order by bm_storage_material.create_time desc, storage_material_no desc

update bm_storage_material set consume_quantity = consume_quantity + reserve_quantity, reserve_quantity = 0, container = null, material_position_id = null where id in
#{item}
